payload.claim: `fake_follow` records only `task_dir`; it never records or asserts on the `verbose`/`interval` keywords `_watch` passes through. Changing `follow(task_dir, verbose=args.all, interval=args.interval)` in `saffron/cli.py` to `follow(task_dir, verbose=False, interval=1.0)` (dropping `--all`/`--interval` wiring entirely) would leave this test, and every other test in the suite, passing — the `--all`/`--interval` CLI flags' effect on `follow` is exercised nowhere. `follow`'s own `verbose=True` behavior is tested directly in `tests/test_watch.py`, but the argparse-to-`follow` handoff for these two flags is not.
